text:
Amanda R: Heads-up: yesterday we shipped rubric v2.1 which changes weighting for 'impact' from 40% -> 30%. Calibration lead saw unexpected grade shifts in the panel sims. Need a quick sync before we freeze exports.

Evelyn (Calib Lead): I ran the sim overnight and saw ~12% downward shift for senior ICs vs baseline. Looks like some reviewers applied old guidance. We might have mixed rubric versions in active forms.

People Ops Bot: Audit alert: RUBRIC_CHANGE_2026-03-10 applied. Validation check: detected mismatch in rubric_version for active forms (~28 forms with rubric_version=null).

Jess M: Where is rubric_version stored? Per-form meta or global?

Raj P: It's per-form metadata: reviews.forms.meta.rubric_version. Export shows 28 rows with rubric_version==null (likely pre-rollout prefilled forms). Exporting IDs now.

Amanda R: Proposed plan: 1) pause calibration exports immediately, 2) freeze final grades, 3) notify affected managers/reviewers, 4) run a patch for editable forms to attach rubric_version=2.1, 5) for submitted forms with null, ask managers to confirm whether reviewer used old rubric or should re-open.

Evelyn (Calib Lead): Do not auto-patch submitted forms. If submitted and null, managers must confirm. For editable forms it's safe to set rubric_version=2.1.

Raj P: Affected list exported to /internal/people-ops/rubric/2026-03-11/affected_forms.csv (28 rows).

Jess M: I'll draft comms: short explanation, who is affected, actions required (manager confirm / re-open), timeline (we'll hold exports up to 6h while we triage).

People Ops Bot: TASK-7112 created: HOLD_EXPORTS_RUBRIC_MIX. Escalation policy: hold exports until confirmations or 6h timeout.

Amanda R: Also add preflight to runbook: when releasing rubric changes, run a quick validation to ensure every active form has rubric_version set before merge.

Raj P: I'll implement a preflight script and include it in the next deploy pipeline (small PR).

Evelyn (Calib Lead): Quick numbers: 14 editable & null -> safe to patch. 14 submitted & null -> need manager review.

Raj P: JOB-8124 queued to patch editable forms.

People Ops Bot: JOB-8124 executed at 1958765650: patched 14 editable forms with rubric_version=2.1. Remaining 14 submitted forms exported for manager review at /internal/people-ops/rubric/2026-03-11/submitted_null_export.csv.

Jess M: Manager template: "We detected your team's submissions missing rubric version metadata. Reply 'old' if reviewer used prior rubric, 're-score' to re-open for reviewer update, or 'confirm' to accept as-is. Response required within 3 hours to avoid auto-defer of inclusion"

Amanda R: Evelyn: if most of a panel's anchor set reports 'old' we may run calibration with v2.0 weights or re-run the panel. Prefer manager confirmations first.

Evelyn (Calib Lead): Agreed. We'll make the call after responses. Keep the anchor set in mind for variance checks.

People Ops Bot: TASK-7112 update: 10 manager responses received (7 confirm, 2 old, 1 re-score). Pending 4 responses. Deadline in 3h.

Jess M: Collating responses into decision doc for calibration lead. Will tag panel with notes: "mix_detected" and attach manager replies.

Amanda R: Thanks. Holding exports until decision or deadline. Please keep this thread as the single source of truth for the decision.

Raj P: I'll follow up with a PR for preflight validation: PR #5120. Will include a check to fail deploy if any active form lacks rubric_version.

People Ops Bot: TASK-7112 note: set export_cutoff to later if re-run required. Audit log path: /internal/people-ops/audit/TASK-7112/log.json.

Evelyn (Calib Lead): Once manager replies are in I'll run anchor variance analysis and propose next step (adjust weights vs rerun).

Amanda R: Great. Standby for final call.

People Ops Bot: TASK-7112 last update at 1958765852."
